hot wallets are a security bug
Vitalik worries about Europe's drift toward a sanitized internet
summary_en: Trust Wallet browser extension v2.68 shipped malicious code and about $7M was stolen; the team told users to disable and upgrade and promised refunds, and Ethereal later reported a likely link to November's Sha1-Hulud 2 npm supply chain attack. pcaversaccio repeated that hot wallets are a security bug.
